title: Men in Black on Ashaway Road

tellings.quote: It was in it was in um Rhode Island. Uh I lived there in this would have been 1990 when this was happening right around the time of the first Gulf War

plain: In 1990, around the time of the first Gulf War, Peter Levenda, whom the episode presents as a CIA historian, says he had a run-in with Men in Black, the strangers in dark suits who in UFO lore turn up to watch or warn people, on Ashaway Road in Rhode Island, where he lived. He tells Michels it happened to him, and he brings up the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun as he tells it, though what the men did stays vague in what he gives here.
